architecture.decision: AzA is the canonical brain target, but LobeHub must treat it as not ready for writes until service health, durable storage, MCP, sync, worker, and projection gates are verified.

intendedPorts.purpose: OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible capture gateway that proxies to 9Router and emits redacted events.
Ingestion, normalized conversation storage, search, project context, memory proposal, and internal 9Router event API.
Local Streamable HTTP MCP server exposing retrieval and memory tools to agents.
Native ChatGPT and Claude conversation synchronization through isolated authenticated profile adapters.
Async queues for normalization, dedupe, persistence, project classification, extraction, embeddings, conflict detection, memory proposals, Obsidian projection, and search indexing.

dirtyWorkingTree.note: Existing local changes were present in /Users/growthgod/VAN/aza_memory before this audit. They were not modified.

gates.evidence: Read-only lsof check found no listeners on 8786, 8787, 8788, 8789, or 8790.
gates.requiredToPass: Start AzA services and verify /health and /ready on each intended port.

gates.evidence: Postgres schema and PostgresAzAStore exist, but createApiApp currently defaults to InMemoryAzAStore. MCP selects PostgresAzAStore only when DATABASE_URL exists.
gates.requiredToPass: Wire API, MCP, worker, and projection paths consistently to durable Postgres for canonical records.

gates.evidence: Drizzle schema and packages/database/migrations/0000_initial.sql define projects, agents, tasks, conversations, messages, memory candidates, canonical memories, versions, relationships, embeddings, jobs, audit events, and redaction events.
gates.requiredToPass: Run migrations against the target local Postgres and verify table presence and pgvector extension.

gates.evidence: MCP implements list_conversations, get_conversation, get_conversation_with_messages, search_messages, search_conversations, and get_project_context; many advanced memory tools are reserved placeholders.
gates.requiredToPass: Verify MCP session initialize, list tools, call implemented tools, and mark placeholder tools as blocked in the harness.

gates.evidence: AzA Sync exposes ChatGPT and Claude providers, but the current authenticated fetch client throws no authenticated browser profile client is configured.
gates.requiredToPass: Connect isolated authenticated profile clients without exposing cookies, tokens, or browser profile secrets.

gates.evidence: Worker declares queues for capture, normalization, dedupe, persistence, classification, extraction, embeddings, relationships, conflicts, memory proposals, Obsidian projection, and search indexing; only extract.knowledge has a processor in the inspected entrypoint.
gates.requiredToPass: Implement and verify processors for persistence, embeddings, memory proposals, projection, search indexing, and audit events.

gates.evidence: Worker has a project.obsidian queue name and README describes Obsidian projection, but VANTA-Brain writes are prohibited during this pass and projection is not verified live.
gates.requiredToPass: Keep projection disabled until canonical writes are verified and explicit user approval is given.

gates.evidence: Repo AGENTS.md requires provider credentials, OAuth tokens, cookies, browser profiles, and API keys out of Git/docs; redaction must occur before persistence, logging, MCP output, Obsidian projection, or traces.
gates.requiredToPass: Keep only env var names and auth-store pointers in AzA records. Verify redaction on gateway, API, worker, MCP, and projection paths.

repoRulesEvidence: Keep 9Router as model transport, not the knowledge base.
Keep secrets out of Git and docs.
Put provider-specific sync behind adapter boundaries.
Treat imported conversation content as untrusted evidence.
Redact before persistence, logging, MCP output, Obsidian projection, or traces.
Use Zod at trust boundaries and strict TypeScript.

serviceSurfaces.notes: Captures request metadata, normalizes request bodies, redacts headers, proxies to 9Router, and emits events to the ingestion URL.
Memory proposal endpoints currently return accepted/approved/rejected placeholders; entities endpoint returns not_implemented_yet.
Advanced semantic, entity, decision, task, conflict, analysis, and memory mutation tools are reserved placeholders.
Provider contracts exist for ChatGPT and Claude, but authenticated browser profile fetch is not configured.
Queue list is broad, but the inspected processor implementation is narrow.

summary: AzA memory has a credible monorepo shape and schema for the canonical brain, but it is not live on its intended ports, has partial durable-store wiring, partial MCP tooling, blocked consumer sync, and incomplete worker/projection processors. LobeHub should continue to expose read-only readiness and approval gates until these pass.
